mapper.sql: (select x.external_id from mst_ext_id_map x where x.entity_type = 'ITEM' and x.use_yn = 'Y' and x.internal_id = i.item_id and x.system_id = (select s.system_id from mst_ext_system s where s.system_type = 'ERP' and s.use_yn = 'Y' order by s.system_cd limit 1))

select 'WO:' || w.wo_no as biz_key, (w.done_at at time zone #{zone})::date as day, w.done_at as occurred_at, w.wo_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, as erp_item_cd, trim_scale((select c.eff_good_qty from prd_wo_proc_close c join prd_wo_proc p on p.wo_proc_id = c.wo_proc_id where c.wo_id = w.wo_id order by p.op_seq desc limit 1)) as qty, trim_scale((select coalesce(sum(c.scrap_qty), 0) from prd_wo_proc_close c where c.wo_id = w.wo_id)) as scrap_qty, w.unit_cd, null as wh_cd, null as lot_no, 'KEY' as entry_method from prd_wo w join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id

select 'RCV:' || r.receipt_id as biz_key, (r.occurred_at at time zone #{zone})::date as day, r.occurred_at, w.wo_no, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, as erp_item_cd, trim_scale(r.qty) as qty, null as scrap_qty, r.unit_cd, h.node_cd as wh_cd, l.lot_no, r.entry_method from prd_receipt r join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = r.wo_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id join lot_master l on l.lot_id = r.lot_id join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = r.node_id

choose.when: where w.done_at >= #{fromAt} and w.done_at < #{toAt} order by w.done_at, w.wo_id
choose.otherwise: where r.occurred_at >= #{fromAt} and r.occurred_at < #{toAt} order by r.occurred_at, r.receipt_id

choose.when: select count(*) from prd_wo w where w.done_at >= #{fromAt} and w.done_at < #{toAt}
choose.otherwise: select count(*) from prd_receipt r where r.occurred_at >= #{fromAt} and r.occurred_at < #{toAt}

choose.when: select count(*) from prd_wo w join mst_item i on i.item_id = w.item_id where w.done_at >= #{fromAt} and w.done_at < #{toAt} and is null
choose.otherwise: select count(*) from prd_receipt r join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id where r.occurred_at >= #{fromAt} and r.occurred_at < #{toAt} and is null

mapper.insert: insert into prd_erp_export (comp_cd, kind, from_day, to_day, row_cnt, exported_at, exported_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{kind}, #{from}, #{to}, #{rowCnt}, #{at}, #{by})
